TESTED_BY AUDIT — script bug found. The 19 reported drops are really 10 duplicate emissions (correctly deduped) plus 9 genuine drops that were WRONG. Batches emitted 120 tested_by edges over 110 unordered-unique pairs; 101 survived. All 9 wrongly-dropped edges are production -> backend/test/*.e2e-spec.ts with both endpoints present as nodes and already in the correct orientation. Before the fix the graph contained ZERO tested_by edges targeting backend/test/, so every e2e coverage relationship in the project had been erased. Root cause: the merge script's test-file heuristic does not recognize backend/test/*.e2e-spec.ts as test files, so production -> e2e pairs were misclassified as prod<->prod and dropped. Restored all 9 and tagged the 3 newly-covered production nodes 'tested'.

The 3 flipped tested_by edges are correct. Batches 9-part-1/9-part-2 emitted spec -> source (sqlite-document.repository, knowledge-extraction.service, sqlite-knowledge-extraction.repository); the graph now holds source -> spec, i.e. production -> test as intended.

CROSS-BATCH IMPORT CHECK: clean. All 700 import relationships in scan-result.json importMap have a matching `imports` edge (700 imports edges in the graph), and every endpoint resolves to an existing file node. Zero gaps, so zero speculative edges added.

SYSTEMIC SCANNER DEFECT (upstream, not fixed here): the scanner resolves no `export *` / re-export targets at all. Every barrel has an empty importMap entry — frontend/src/{api,discussions,documents,knowledge-extraction}/index.ts, frontend/src/utils/{date,routing}/index.ts, shared/src/index.ts — as does the re-exporting module frontend/src/discussions/discussionModel.ts. Consequence: barrels are traversal sinks. Consumers reach them (documents/index.ts has 8 incoming imports, discussions/index.ts has 10) but the barrels have no outgoing edges to the modules they re-export. This is the same root cause as the 6 priority drops. The fix belongs in the scanner's export-* resolution, not in per-barrel patching.
